from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json

source = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-community-directory/raw/recent-closed-pulls.json')
raw = source.read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert digest == '6f177c8027b66ba09a57b90f90f582cfeab753ada8d0a859b89098531cfcf4c6', 'Capture differs from host receipt'
pulls = json.loads(raw)
assert isinstance(pulls, list) and len(pulls) <= 5
selected_fields = ('number', 'created_at', 'updated_at', 'closed_at', 'merged_at')
records = [{field: item.get(field) for field in selected_fields} for item in pulls]
result = {'source': 'https://api.github.com/repos/planetopendata/awesome-sqlite/pulls?state=closed&sort=updated&direction=desc&per_page=5', 'receipt': 'TASK-179550156102', 'sha256': digest, 'count': len(records), 'merge_count': sum(bool(item['merged_at']) for item in records), 'records': records, 'coverage': 'At most five closed pull requests ordered by last update. Merge timestamps establish recorded merges. Compare the actual changes and README entries before judging listing fit. This sample cannot establish repository-wide activity, submission eligibility, or demand.'}
output = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-community-directory/director-merge-timestamps.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
